name: Agentik
summary: Hosted MCP and REST gateway giving agents 3,500+ third-party tools from 165 providers, billed per call from one prepaid balance with the price shown before each call.

agent_access.notes: OAuth or a workspace API key as a Bearer token. https://ai.agentik.cc/mcp/public offers discovery and inspection without an account. The repo holds the MIT SDK, CLI and Claude Code plugin; the hosted service is closed source.
